edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender argument into _transfer from transfer and transferFrom.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the origin of the transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for allowance bookkeeping.
approve grants allowance to the caller spender.
claim forwards msg.sender into dividendTracker.processAccount.
compound forwards msg.sender into dividendTracker.compoundAccount.
rescueToken sends arbitrary tokens directly to msg.sender, the onlyOwner caller.
rescueETH sends contract ETH directly to msg.sender, the onlyOwner caller.
Owner controlled parameters reach an external token transfer to the caller.
Owner controlled amount reaches the ETH send to the caller.
_transfer delegates all balance mutation to _executeTransfer.
_transfer invokes _executeSwap which performs external router calls mid-transfer.
_executeSwap calls swapTokensForNative for the aggregated swap amount.
_executeSwap calls addLiquidity with the collected native liquidity share.
_executeSwap transfers native value to the marketing wallet during token transfer.
_executeSwap performs a low level call with value to the dividend tracker.
swapTokensForNative performs the router swap external call.
addLiquidity performs the router addLiquidityETH external call.
_transfer calls dividendTracker.setBalance after token movements, re-entering external code.
claim triggers the tracker payout path that sends ETH to the caller.
compound triggers the tracker compounding path performing a router swap.
processAccount delegates payout to _withdrawDividendOfUser.
_withdrawDividendOfUser sends ETH to a user controlled address before completing checks.
withdrawnDividends is written and conditionally reverted around the external ETH call.
compoundAccount delegates to _compoundDividendOfUser.
_compoundDividendOfUser executes a router swap with the user dividend ETH.
Tracker receive hook distributes dividends on plain ETH transfers.
magnifiedDividendPerShare is increased by msg.value scaled over _totalSupply.
_transfer checks taxEnabled before charging fees.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before triggering the auto swap.
_transfer toggles the swapping flag as an informal reentrancy guard.
isOpen gates whether non whitelisted accounts may transfer.
_transfer enforces blacklist checks on sender and recipient.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to decide fee taking and swap skipping.
_whiteList bypasses the isOpen trading gate.
_transfer reads balances for limit and contract balance checks.
_executeTransfer writes the adjusted balances.
The computed fee amount is moved out through _executeTransfer.
totalFeeBPS scales the fee amount inside _transfer.
_executeSwap splits tokens using treasury, dividend and total fee basis points.
lastSwapTime is updated from block.timestamp inside _transfer.
swapTokensForNative uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
processAccount stores block.timestamp as the last claim time.
compoundAccount stores block.timestamp as the last claim time.
_setBalance mints when the new balance is larger.
_setBalance burns when the new balance is smaller.
_mint subtracts a magnified correction that can underflow signed arithmetic expectations.
_burn adds a magnified correction to the signed corrections mapping.
openTrading sets isOpen and is restricted to the owner.
maxTxBPS bounds the allowed transfer amount.
maxWalletBPS bounds the recipient wallet balance.
Owner controlled setFee rewrites totalFeeBPS and therefore all fee arithmetic.
setBalance routes to _setBalance for the actual share update.
REFLECT.excludeFromDividends calls the tracker exclusion function.
REFLECT.manualSendDividend calls the tracker manual payout.
Tracker manualSendDividend performs an ETH transfer to a holder address.
Owner controlled excludeFromFees writes the fee exclusion mapping.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the DEX pair registry.
The REFLECT constructor mints the initial supply.
includeToWhiteList writes the white list mapping.
_mint increases balances directly.
_burn decreases balances directly.
blackListMany writes the blacklist mapping in an uint8 bounded loop.
blackList writes the blacklist mapping.
removeFromBlacklist clears the blacklist mapping.
_withdrawDividendOfUser reads the withdrawable amount from the view helper.
withdrawableDividendOf derives from accumulativeDividendOf.
accumulativeDividendOf combines signed accumulator and correction values.
accumulativeDividendOf multiplies magnifiedDividendPerShare by the account balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only meaningful as an input of the _transfer core function.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful as an input of the _transfer core function.
The amount parameter drives the limit and fee logic of _transfer.
The tokens parameter is only consumed by the swap split logic in _executeSwap.
The account parameter is the destination of the low level ETH payout.
The holder parameter is the destination of the ETH transfer in the tracker payout.
The computed fee local is forwarded to _executeTransfer for the actual balance mutation.
The takeFee flag only controls branching inside _transfer.
The cached contract token balance is passed into _executeSwap as its swap input.
The local withdrawable amount is the value forwarded in the low level call.
The cached sender balance is only used for the arithmetic inside _executeTransfer.
